Name: Sign Venue Contract with AV Recording Confirmation
Description: Diego is responsible for getting the venue contract reviewed by legal and signed by the end of next week. He must also confirm that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall plus two breakout rooms) to avoid last year's issue where breakout talks were not recorded.

Name: Finalize Speakers Lineup
Description: Bo will send final follow-ups to the two 'maybe' speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If necessary, he will select a third speaker from a backup list of five names. The final lineup of nine speakers must be locked in two weeks to enable agenda printing.

Name: Obtain Keynote Abstract
Description: Bo is tasked with chasing Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is required for the website and the printed program.

Name: Run Email Campaign for Registration
Description: Diego will draft three email waves this month: (1) agenda announcement sent the day the speaker lineup locks, (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before price change, and (3) final-week push. The campaign aims to increase registration from the current 340 toward the target of 600.

Name: Update Website Speaker Pages
Description: Bo must provide speaker bios and headshots to Diego on the same day the lineup locks. Diego will then update the website landing page with these materials before the first email wave is launched.

Name: Approve and Place Swag Order
Description: Camille will review the swag design proofs today. Upon approval, Diego will place the order for 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers this week. The lead time is six weeks, so timely approval is critical to meet event deadlines.
